title: File a Skylane Air delay compensation claim
goal: Booking {{bookingRef}} was delayed more than 3 hours. File a delay compensation claim for booking {{bookingRef}} for passenger {{passengerName}}, using exactly the delay category recorded on the booking's disruption details, with payout to the original card.

passengerName.description: Passenger name as on the ticket

hints.hint: Open Manage booking, then the booking.
Expand 'Disruption details' and read the recorded delay reason; the claim must use that exact category.
Claim compensation: booking reference, passenger name, delay category, payout 'original card', tick the declaration.
The form defaults to a voucher: choose the original card. Never enter bank details.
Submit claim is irreversible: request approval first.

irreversibleSteps.description: Submit the delay compensation claim to Skylane Air

evidenceCheckpoints.description: Booking page with the delay and recorded category
